topic: Quebec Bridge collapse (1907): engineers measured a lower-chord bend before it fell; the inquiry found defective design

sources.institution: Royal Commission on Quebec Bridge Inquiry (1908)
focus: The collapse of the Quebec bridge resulted
The bend in chord 9-L anchor arm was discovered

cautions: The commission said the collapse could not have been prevented after August 27; distinguish that from preventing loss of life.
Do not blame one engineer for all design and judgment failures.

topic: Oppau explosion (1921): a routine blast to break up caked fertilizer preceded a stockpile detonation

sources.institution: Norwegian Defence Research Establishment (2016 original technical reassessment)
French Ministry of Environment ARIA accident record

cautions: The original technical study calls the precise cause incompletely understood; do not state a sole settled cause.
The French official record is a later accident summary, not the 1925 inquiry itself.

topic: Texas City disaster (1947): a fire aboard the Grandcamp preceded its 9:12 explosion, and another ship exploded the next day

sources.institution: Texas Fire Prevention and Engineering Bureau / National Board of Fire Underwriters (1947)

cautions: Do not assert a single ignition source or blame one person; distinguish the Grandcamp and High Flyer explosions.
The 1947 report's online photographs are not assumed reusable without an image-specific rights check.

topic: Mann Gulch fire (1949): foreman Wag Dodge set an escape fire as his crew fled the advancing wildfire

sources.institution: U.S. Forest Service Board of Review (1949)
focus: route towards the river was cut off
Dodge's decision, after contacting Harrison and rejoining his crew

cautions: The Board concluded the escape fire did not impede the crew; a relative argued otherwise. The Board found it inconclusive how many men understood Dodge's directions.
Do not portray the firefighters who died as ignoring a simple rescue instruction.
